source_snapshot.procedure: Use LTSSM tooling for 500 Gen1-to-Gen4 speed changes.
source_snapshot.criteria: Each link transition reaches expected Gen4 speed and width with no errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; names the NVIDIA tool dependency but lacks Gen4 channel/equalization qualification and atomic transition evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; kept Pending for the Speed Change 14 artifact, Gen4 path, training/equalization oracle, aborts and recovery.

old_problem: The old review lacked a pinned Speed Change 14 recipe, complete Gen4-capable physical hierarchy, required width, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle deadline and error rule, so it could not accept a generic final-state link check.
disposition_reason: The Master provides a complete review-level purpose and oracle: five hundred Gen1-to-Gen4 transitions that achieve the expected width/speed without errors. Project owners can bind the proprietary action, capability map and numerical/time/error acceptance. Pending is removed, while execution remains BLOCKED unless the entire path proves Gen4 capability and every transaction preserves its equalization trajectory and raw evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2103, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2104 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00026-V002 / 2caae9e651980e7f was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 14 is Gen1-to-Gen4 coverage and cannot be satisfied by adjacent Gen2, Gen3 or Gen5 rows even when tooling is shared.
Before stress, verify Gen4 at required width across root port, every switch/retimer and physical segment, endpoint/GPU and firmware configuration.
The exact owner-supplied recipe defines Gen1 entry, Gen4 request and permitted equalization/LTSSM intermediate states; no sequence is inferred from lower-generation tests.
Each transaction records initial, requested, equalization/intermediate and settled Gen4/full-width states with enumeration, timestamp, error delta and platform health.
All 500 raw atomic outcomes remain; a lower generation/reduced width, missing artifact or replay cannot be accepted as coverage.
Hard-stop before the next transition on capability/equalization/settle failure, width loss, new disqualifying AER, endpoint loss/reset, data gap or thermal/power anomaly.
No LTSSM/NVQual, Gen1/Gen4 speed change, equalization, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove a certified GB-NV-PVP Gen4 PCIe path repeatedly transitions from Gen1 to Gen4 at required lane width five hundred times with valid equalization, no disqualifying errors and stable platform health.
required_package: Pinned approved Gen4-capable NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 14 build, command and configuration
Immutable lane/path map and required Gen4 width
Gen1 entry, Gen4 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle timeout and error policy
Dedicated SUT, 500-entry durable ledger, first-fault inhibit, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Gen4 capability and all Project Configuration are signed. Preserve topology/link/AER/kernel/BMC/GPU baselines; with point approval run only the exact Speed Change 14 action for numbered transactions 1..500. Before each subsequent release, persist the prior transaction's Gen1 start, Gen4 request, equalization/LTSSM path, settled generation/width, enumeration, error delta and health. Stop on first deviation or evidence gap; do not downscope, clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every path component supports the target and all 500 transactions follow an allowed equalization path and settle to Gen4 at required width within deadline, with endpoint/sibling presence and no new disqualifying PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power event; approved final topology/health is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is unavailable until capability/tool/path/time/error inputs are approved. Then PASS requires 500 complete Gen4/full-width records and clean correlated health. FAIL on unsupported component, downtrain/reduced width, equalization/settle violation, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing artifact/configuration is BLOCKED; lower-speed or repeated results cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until full-path Gen4 capability, Speed Change 14 semantics, equalization oracle, error/abort policy and recovery are approved.
Use an isolated SUT with stable power/cooling, console recovery and fresh point authorization.
Durably store raw intermediate and final state plus errors before enabling the next transition.
Inhibit all further changes at the first capability, equalization, width, endpoint, error, evidence or safety anomaly; no retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, tool/configuration identity and authorization
Complete Gen4 path capability/firmware/lane map and required width
Signed Gen1-entry, Gen4-request, equalization/LTSSM, timeout/transient/error contract
Monotonic ledger 1..500 with raw initial/intermediate/settled states, width, enumeration and timestamps
First-fault/recovery or clean final Gen4 topology/health, no-downscope/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported capability, failed equalization/settle, reduced width, endpoint or sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap, freeze the loop and preserve that transaction. Do not fall back to Gen3 or replay. Apply signed console recovery and quarantine if required Gen4 topology and health are not proven.

source_conflict.reason: The row consistently specifies 500 Gen1-to-Gen4 transitions; missing capability/tool/limits are project configuration rather than conflicting requirements.

blocked.reason: The review-layer case is complete; actual execution remains conditional on demonstrable Gen4 support and approved proprietary inputs.
